evidence_boundary: M17 Release and Install Hardening packages the accepted DoctorCode CLI and local stdio MCP server as deterministic versioned archives for linux/darwin/windows on amd64/arm64. Archives contain both binaries plus README, LICENSE, and the DoctorCode Agent Skill; release-manifest.json and checksums.txt bind target, size, SHA-256, version, commit, and build date. Installers verify the native archive before extraction and do not modify PATH automatically. Public tag/release publication remains blocked until M17 is MAIN_ACCEPTED. M17 does not enlarge analyzer, verification, Skill, or MCP proof boundaries.
